title: Top Stand Mixers for Holiday Baking (2026)
summary: The top stand mixers for holiday baking are the KitchenAid Artisan Plus, Cuisinart SM‑50, Hamilton Beach 6‑speed, and Ankarsrum Assistent, each chosen for their strong performance, versatility, and repeat praise across multiple trusted reviews.
method: Selected products that appear in at least two of the provided sources (Consumer Reports, Good Housekeeping, Tom’s Guide, CNET).
assumptions: Prices are only included when explicitly stated in a source; otherwise price is null.

products.name: KitchenAid Artisan Plus Stand Mixer
why: Strong performance in lab tests and real‑world baking, praised for its 11 speed settings and durable construction.
Includes a built‑in bowl light, 1/2 speed and Slow Start for gentle mixing, and a variety of attachments for versatility.
specs: Attachments: Flat beater, double flex‑edge beater, dough hook, wire whip, pouring shield
cons: Head can become unlocked with stiff doughs
Not all attachments are dishwasher safe
products.best_for: Home bakers who want a reliable, all‑purpose mixer
products.skip_if: You need a very compact or ultra‑budget option

products.name: Cuisinart SM‑50 Precision Master Stand Mixer
why: Offers a good amount of speed settings for a budget pick and is praised for its solid performance in both lab and home tests.
Its 5‑quart bowl and 350‑watt motor provide reliable mixing for everyday baking.
cons: Not all attachments are dishwasher safe
products.best_for: Budget‑conscious bakers who still want a dependable mixer
products.skip_if: You need advanced smart features or a very large capacity

products.name: Hamilton Beach 6‑Speed Stand Mixer
why: Most affordable option on the list, praised for its simplicity and ease of use for new bakers.
Provides six speed settings and a sturdy base for stable mixing.
specs: Attachments: Flat beater, dough hook, wire whip
products.best_for: Beginners or those who need a simple, no‑frills mixer
products.skip_if: You need advanced features or a larger capacity
